def get_positive(l: list):
    
    return [e for e in l if e > 0]



# Unit test for function get_positive
def test_get_positive():
    # Basic mixed list
    assert get_positive([-1, 2, -4, 5, 6]) == [2, 5, 6]
    # All positive numbers
    assert get_positive([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 123, 1, -10]) == [5, 3, 2, 3, 9, 123, 1]
    # All negative numbers
    assert get_positive([-1, -2, -4, -5, -6]) == []
    # Empty list
    assert get_positive([]) == []
    # Includes zero (zero is not positive)
    assert get_positive([0, 1, 0, -1]) == [1]
    # Floats and ints mixed
    assert get_positive([-1.5, 2.5, 3, -0.1]) == [2.5, 3]
    # Single positive element
    assert get_positive([42]) == [42]
    # Duplicates preserved
    assert get_positive([1, 1, 2, -2, 1]) == [1, 1, 2, 1]
    # Order preserved
    assert get_positive([-5, 10, -15, 20]) == [10, 20]

def test_get_positive():
    # Basic mixed case
    assert get_positive([-1, 2, -4, 5, 6]) == [2, 5, 6]
    assert get_positive([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 123, 1, -10]) == [5, 3, 2, 3, 9, 123, 1]

    # Empty list
    assert get_positive([]) == []

    # All negative numbers
    assert get_positive([-1, -2, -3, -4]) == []

    # All positive numbers
    assert get_positive([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]

    # Zero is not positive
    assert get_positive([0, 0, 0]) == []
    assert get_positive([0, 1, -1, 0]) == [1]

    # Single element lists
    assert get_positive([7]) == [7]
    assert get_positive([-7]) == []

    # Floats
    assert get_positive([-1.5, 2.5, 3.0, -0.1]) == [2.5, 3.0]
    assert get_positive([0.1]) == [0.1]

    # Duplicates preserved
    assert get_positive([2, 2, -2, 2]) == [2, 2, 2]

    # Order is preserved
    assert get_positive([-5, 10, -3, 20, -1, 30]) == [10, 20, 30]
